results.content: An average of national polls has 38.6 percent of Americans giving Trump a thumbs up today, a 0.4-point increase from where he stood on August 3. In comparison, 57.7 percent give him a thumbs down, a drop of 1.1 points from last month’s number. Trump’s net approval rating now stands at -19.1 points. His lowest number so far this year was the -20.6 points he recorded last month.

results.content: A recent Fox News analysis found that among rural voters, Trump’s net job approval fell from +20 in early 2025 to -14 in May 2026. A recent article by Brookings senior fellow, William A. Galston, pointed to the fact that Trump carried 64% of the rural vote to Kamala Harris’s 34% in 2024. He believes that in November, while Republican voters may not choose to cast their ballot for Democratic candidates, there’s a strong possibility more will choose not to vote at all. [...] This apparent defiance against the 47th president among registered Republican voters seems to be increasingly common, with the president’s preferences in Iowa, Georgia and South Carolina’s gubernatorial races all losing.
